description: Establish the local verification baseline for this no-build static site under the INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox (no npm/Playwright), and create the feature branch for issue #209. Baseline = node --check on the files this task will touch + JSON parse + a demonstration that pure-logic specs can be executed with plain node (since `npx playwright test` cannot run offline). This confirms the working state is green BEFORE making changes so any later failure is attributable to the change.
steps: Confirm NODE_OPTIONS handling: this sandbox sets NODE_OPTIONS=--require /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js which does NOT exist, so every node invocation MUST be prefixed with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` (or run after `unset NODE_OPTIONS`). Confirm `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --version` prints a v22 version.

Confirm the git baseline: `git switch main` and `git pull` (already on main at 564b6de). Then create the feature branch: `git switch -c feature/issue-209-exam-guide-hyde`. All #209 work happens on this branch. Do NOT push (the orchestrator pushes).

Baseline node --check on the files this task touches: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/resourceSearch.js`, `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/exams.js`. Confirm all pass on the untouched tree.

Baseline pure-spec executability: demonstrate that a pure-logic spec's assertions can be run WITHOUT Playwright by importing the module under test directly with node. Example one-liner (do NOT commit it): `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --input-type=module -e "import('./js/resourceSearch.js').then(m=>{const i=m.buildResourceIndex();console.log('index size', i.length); console.log('S3+IAM', m.searchResourcesMulti(i,['S3','IAM']).length>0);})"`. Confirm it prints a non-zero index size and true. Record that `npx playwright test` itself cannot run (no cached browsers / offline).
Record the baseline results (commands + outputs) in this feature's findings so the coder for FEAT-002 can rely on the same verification recipe.
acceptance_criteria: Feature branch feature/issue-209-exam-guide-hyde exists and is checked out from the latest main.
`env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check` passes for js/ui.js, js/resourceSearch.js, js/exams.js on the untouched tree.
A node --input-type=module import of js/resourceSearch.js succeeds and buildResourceIndex() returns a non-empty array (proves pure specs are runnable offline).
Findings document the exact verification recipe (env -u NODE_OPTIONS node ...) and note that npx playwright test cannot run in-sandbox.
verification: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/resourceSearch.js && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/exams.js
findings:
Baseline verified GREEN on untouched tree at main=564b6de, before creating any #209 changes.

ENV: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --version` => v22.23.2. NODE_OPTIONS in this sandbox points at a non-existent /opt/amazon/kiro-agent/proxy-bootstrap.js, so EVERY node/npx invocation MUST be prefixed with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` or it fails.

BRANCH: created `feature/issue-209-exam-guide-hyde` from main (git switch -c). Currently checked out (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD => feature/issue-209-exam-guide-hyde). Not pushed (orchestrator pushes).

SYNTAX CHECK (all passed on untouched tree):
  env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/ui.js            => ui.js OK
  env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/resourceSearch.js => resourceSearch.js OK
  env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check js/exams.js         => exams.js OK

PURE-SPEC OFFLINE RECIPE (proves pure logic runs without Playwright/browser/network):
  env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --input-type=module -e "import('./js/resourceSearch.js').then(m=>{const i=m.buildResourceIndex();if(!Array.isArray(i)||i.length===0)process.exit(1);console.log('index size', i.length); console.log('S3+IAM', m.searchResourcesMulti(i,['S3','IAM']).length>0);})"
  => index size 1143 ; S3+IAM true
  (A benign MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning prints because package.json has no "type":"module"; it is harmless and can be ignored.)

CANNOT RUN IN-SANDBOX: `npx playwright test` (and `npm test`, a placeholder that always exits 1) cannot run under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY — no cached Playwright browsers and no npm registry access. Verify pure-logic specs by importing the module under test directly with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --input-type=module` as shown above; do NOT treat the inability to run Playwright as a failure.

VERIFICATION RECIPE for FEAT-002+ (reuse this): 1) `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check <changed .js>` for every changed JS incl. new modules/specs. 2) `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node -e \"JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('<file>','utf8'))\"` for changed JSON. 3) import changed pure module(s) via `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --input-type=module -e ...` and assert expected output (e.g. 'Quick' expansion surfaces Amazon QuickSight / Amazon Q). 4) For i18n changes confirm ja.json/en.json flattened key sets mirror.
